## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
ROTATION, Value/Cyclical style. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive; cyclicals (Energy/Materials/Utilities) and select defensives are outperforming while Tech and Financials lag — Leadership: Broad (Top 5 from 5 sectors).  

2. Which sectors are leading?
Utilities lead: CEG (1W: +11.88% | 1M: +14.56%) ABOVE TREND, SOFT utility flows visible; Communication strong: NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND, TTWO (1W: +5.89% | 1M: -13.04%) RECOVERY; Healthcare showing breadth: JNJ (1W: +2.99% | 1M: +9.67%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +4.21% | 1M: +2.92%) ABOVE TREND.  

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Financials are weak: broad bank weakness (BAC (1W: -6.09% | 1M: -3.82%) BELOW TREND, GS (1W: -6.80% | 1M: -8.25%) BELOW TREND, AXP (1W: -10.77% | 1M: -13.47%) BELOW TREND). Technology shows Sector Weakness with major names BELOW TREND: NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -1.13% | 1M: -18.27%) BELOW TREND.  

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND; CEG (1W: +11.88% | 1M: +14.56%) ABOVE TREND; PYPL (1W: +10.95% | 1M: -14.55%) RECOVERY; INTU (1W: +7.48% | 1M: -24.07%) RECOVERY; NEM (1W: +6.44% | 1M: -1.48%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Broad (5 sectors in Top 5).  

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: AXP (1W: -10.77% | 1M: -13.47%) BELOW TREND; MET (1W: -8.89% | 1M: -4.82%) BELOW TREND; PNC (1W: -8.85% | 1M: -4.08%) BELOW TREND; WFC (1W: -8.17% | 1M: -7.02%) BELOW TREND; USB (1W: -6.82% | 1M: -1.94%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Financials.  

6. Momentum Stocks?
Highest 1W momentum: NFLX (1W: +22.33%), CEG (1W: +11.88%), PYPL (1W: +10.95%), INTU (1W: +7.48%), CRM (1W: +5.20%). Major divergence present: multiple large-cap names show 1W gains with negative 1M (RECOVERY) — tactical bounces, not clear structural rotation.  

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech is in Sector Weakness: NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -1.13% | 1M: -18.27%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -1.02% | 1M: -7.22%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: +7.48% | 1M: -24.07%) RECOVERY — Tech breadth negative (Technology: sector weakness).  

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are lagging with concentrated selling: BAC (1W: -6.09% | 1M: -3.82%) BELOW TREND, GS (1W: -6.80% | 1M: -8.25%) BELOW TREND, PNC (1W: -8.85% | 1M: -4.08%) BELOW TREND — Financials: sector weakness (20 stocks).  

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare showing resilience and selective leadership: JNJ (1W: +2.99% | 1M: +9.67%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +4.21% | 1M: +2.92%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +3.75% | 1M: +6.92%) ABOVE TREND — Healthcare: Internal Rotation/strength within defensive names.  

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Energy/Materials and select Utilities and Healthcare exposure (XOM (1W: +3.54% | 1M: +11.58%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.54% | 1M: +10.98%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +5.81% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND). Reduce exposure to extended Financial laggards and large-cap Tech that are BELOW TREND (NVDA, MSFT, GS); monitor RECOVERY names (PYPL, INTU, CRM) for follow-through before reallocation. Style: Value/Cyclical tilt within a ROTATION regime.  

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND; CEG (1W: +11.88% | 1M: +14.56%) ABOVE TREND; LLY (1W: +4.21% | 1M: +2.92%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND; MSFT (1W: -1.13% | 1M: -18.27%) BELOW TREND; AXP (1W: -10.77% | 1M: -13.47%) BELOW TREND.  

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Utilities (sector positive), Energy (sector positive) and Materials (sector positive) — watch commodity- and yield-driven flows.  
BEARISH: Financials (sector weak) and Technology (sector weak) — monitor for spillover if breadth narrows.  

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA: watch reclaim of recent 1W range for trend confirmation or break of the 1W low for further downside (NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND). AAPL: failure to hold 1M trend would signal deeper Tech pullback (AAPL (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +3.11%) CORRECTION). JPM/Bank group: further breakdown below recent weekly pivot would confirm Financials rotation risk (JPM (1W: -3.38% | 1M: -0.16%) BELOW TREND).  

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LLY (+65): Eli Lilly GLP‑1/Olumiant update; price confirming: LLY (1W: +4.21% | 1M: +2.92%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment and price aligned.  
(Other top bullish headlines include ASML and TJX in the news feed but those names are outside or not in our SP100 price set for cross-reference today.)  

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
NVDA (-50): Street rotation away from AI chips; price confirms weakness — NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND.  
INTU (-50): price/price-action diverging — INTU (1W: +7.48% | 1M: -24.07%) RECOVERY (negative headline vs short-term bounce = divergence).  
IBM (-45): negative sentiment aligned with price: IBM (1W: -6.59% | 1M: -17.87%) BELOW TREND.  
MDLZ (-50): negative headlines but price ABOVE TREND — MDLZ (1W: +4.73% | 1M: +6.67%) ABOVE TREND (distribution signal to watch).  

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION, Value/Cyclical style.  
Energy/Materials/Utilities and select Healthcare names are showing relative strength (XOM ABOVE TREND, FCX ABOVE TREND, JNJ ABOVE TREND).  
Key risk: major-cap Tech and Financials remain BELOW TREND and several large-cap RECOVERY bounces (PYPL, INTU, CRM) create divergence—monitor news-confirmation before treating these moves as durable.
